title: Lala is again a tropical storm, sending drenching rain and winds across Hawaii
snippet: Lala is again a tropical storm, sending drenching rain and winds across Hawaii    NPR Thousands without power and at least 100 homes damaged after Tropical Storm Lala lashes Hawaii    CNN School closures: 2 on Hawaii Island closed following Lala storm damage    Hawaii News Now Lala Sunday Updates: Lala continues to bring heavy rain, gusty winds over parts of Maui County and Oʻahu    Maui Now UPDATE: Search and rescue operation underway after several homes swept off foundations in Ka‘ū District    Big Island Now
